family: Standalone WB05RT13; not WB05BR, WB04A or a generic MID10001 alias
evidence_class: Exact-source static trace and public instruction-matched constant leaf vectors. Native leaf replay is a separate callable for the integration owner; no native execution result is claimed here.
crypto_trace: The originally selected 31-function review misses the software authenticated wrappers. It only traced ECB block wrappers and explicitly left CipherV2 unknown; the implementation does not infer crypto from its mbedtls string catalog or PR separate-peer report.

V1.45 n01/decompiled.c:855-867 UDP ingress writes crypto-mode byte=2 before calling selector0x9b02f9f0. V1.54 equivalent socket task0x9b032624 also selects mode2. Mode1 TCP/MQTT paths are not exposed as alternative LAN control fallbacks.

V1.54 FUN_9b030d7c parses outer i/uid/cid/tcid/pack/tag. Mode2 base64-decodes ciphertext and tag; i0 uses device key, i1 initializes the GCM generic key at0x9b038840, then invokes0x9b038a24. Other selector values fail.

V1.54 FUN_9b038a24 initializes a396-byte GCM context, selects cipher-id2/keybits128 using0x9b01a90a, and invokes authenticated decrypt0x9b01ade2(ctx,len,nonce,12,aad,13,tag,16,input,output). Encrypt wrapper0x9b0389b0 uses0x9b01ad98 with mode1, same nonce/AAD and16-byte tag. Fixed values are assembled by the three exact Thumb leaves below, byte-identical in all three original images.

V1.54 FUN_9b03178c serializes replies through the corresponding authenticated encrypt wrapper and base64-encodes pack plus tag. FUN_9b0316b0 echoes request selector/uid and reverses cid/tcid for replies. Response key follows request selector, even for status or commands sent with generic slot1.

Discovery is deliberately a distinct path: FUN_9b031928 scan builds dev, invokes ECB PKCS7 encrypt0x9b028e54 using key getter0x9b02f43c, then forces outer i1 uid0 cid/tcid empty and suppresses GCM tag. Key getter follows halfword pointers in0x10003154..0x10003170; source bytes resolve the standard discovery key. The scan inner cid is device MAC, not empty.

Authenticated payloads have no PKCS7 padding. Runtime requires valid strict16-byte tag/authentication before JSON. Strict duplicate-key, UTF-8 and terminal-garbage rejection intentionally avoids native parser ambiguities. No trailing-brace stripping, nonce invention or fallback decryption is used.
property_trace: Old exact-source FUN_9b02e3f0 emits res/mac/p/opt/r200; FUN_9b02e638 emits dat/uid/mac/cid/dat/cols/r200. New exact-source equivalents0x9b030086 and0x9b0302cc preserve that dialect. Bind0x9b02ef94 emits r200/tbindok/mac/key, defaulting missing inner mac to local identity.

V1.54 FUN_9b02fd40 parses cols first, opt as fallback, through a512-byte packed-name buffer and64-entry output arrays. opt+p mutates the raw cache even on status; cmd+cols does not mutate and acknowledges zero numeric work-buffer values. Unsafe native null-pointer/partial/buffer behavior uses explicit atomic rejection or unknown-column omission.

All495 source table slots are accounted in catalog-wb-standalone_research.json, not only19 familiar AC controls. Numeric commands store low16 bits, getter serialization loads unsigned16, NoD aliases use the first match. Local getters precede the numeric table; ModelType and RT13 FaultDisplay are strings. ver/vender/FaultDisplay numeric writes still target independent raw cache slots, not their metadata getter buffers. DevID/MafIdf retain columns without appending dat values.

V1.45 existing acquisition replay0x9b029ec8 writes unsigned UART frame byte+0x2e unchanged to cache property77; complete status exports preserve it as integer. New exact instructions0x9b02ae50/0x9b02ae56 and0x9b02af20/0x9b02af26 perform the same unsigned load to property77. No Celsius subtraction occurs in this transport.

Local command response arrays partition metadata before raw values. Metadata uses getter-after-set (name/ModelType/AppTimer setters are no-ops, time updates the chosen synthetic RTC); raw p echoes requested integers while fresh status exposes low16. ReportClientID has a setter but contributes no getter value.

PR148 V1.54/V1.64 finite14-entry request registration also reaches timer operations, dump, OTA receipt/queue, ReportCtrl, freqCount, binCmd and reset. wb_operations.py implements qualified local storage/queue semantics and literal tests; reset's original serializer receives string pointer200, so no manufactured numeric success response is emitted.
version_scope: All three identities are exact embedded strings, firmware code362001065279. Only requested MID10001 is registered; no extra MID follows from a generic MID association.

V1.45 receive buffer0x5b4 differs from V1.54/V1.64 buffer0x600. Key/nonce/AAD leaf bytes are identical at distinct source offsets. V1.54/V1.64 bind, crypto parser, reply envelope and block wrappers are text-identical after relocated address normalization.

V1.64 status adds formatting for a conditional auxiliary diagnostic/report branch, and scan reset handling gains a restart guard. Those branches are not represented by the explicitly selected ordinary AC control/status simulation; no whole-firmware implementation equivalence is claimed. Normal property parser changes between1.54/1.64 are a diagnostic source-line constant only.
synthetic_policy: Fresh per-device controls/keys and complete raw cache defaults0; low16 raw command storage with last duplicate winning, independently labeled immediate synthetic reports. Existing thermal step and TemSen=floor(Celsius)+40 clamped0..255 remain uncalibrated policy. Scan buffers bc13zero/verV3.4.M/vender1/ModelType0 are chosen advertisement metadata; status callbacks instead read explicit empty mainboard buffers, zero availability/lock/update, synthetic RSSI-50 and fixed/local-set RTC. Timer/OTA/UART/report queues are local synthetic peripherals, never downloaded firmware, flashed hardware or delivered mainboard actions.
replay_boundary: probe_exact_firmware_constants(paths) in tests/test_emulator_wb_rt13.py hashes all3 supplied images, locates each unique byte-pinned leaf, runs its actual Thumb instructions under Unicorn with only scratch RAM and return LR, and asserts the literal protocol constants. Ordinary public tests use bounded MOVS/STRB/BX translation without Unicorn or vendor images. This probe does not execute AES, application routing, radio, full boot or physical mainboard.
